text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew... That takes care of the grooming.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I need to advise the Beautification 
Committee Chair about buying more leaf 
mold—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...Cherry blossom season has arrived once 
again.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Last year before the Oka Sho, I had a 
chat with Craft right here, didn't I?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, I was... completely beside 
myself. Facing the first leg of the Triple 
Tiara, desperate to avenge my mother's 
regrets.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (And yet, right now—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... pardon? Me, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes. Air Messiah-san...! Um, err—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"M-My running! Even just for a bit, could 
you please take a look...!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: I want Air Messiah... to watch me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"Both the Shuka Sho and the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup! I watched them 
on-site... I couldn't take my eyes off you 
the entire time!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
You were the coolest of all!! You shone 
the brightest...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
You're... my inspiration. My absolute 
number one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The color of those eyes... I know it. I 
know it all too well.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (The way I look at Mother—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Um... w-what do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...My answer. I ended up putting it on 
hold.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I feel awful for what I did to her. 
Still... thanks to that, one thing became 
crystal clear.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I really have no... confidence, do I?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(What I truly aspire to is "succession." 
Just as my mother was to me, I want to be 
a guide for others—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, when I realized that the one who 
must achieve it is not 'me, the daughter,' 
but 'me, myself'—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (My footing... suddenly gives way.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Because I am filled with Mother. 
...Filled with everything Mother gave me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The strength and pride I hold today... If 
you trace it back to the source, it all 
belongs to Mother.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(If so, once I strip away 'me as a 
daughter,' what is left of 'myself'—?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Sometimes, even knowing the steadiness 
inherited from my mother is a strength, I 
find myself clumsily yearning for 
something 'transcendent'.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've always... I've never had any 
confidence in myself, have I—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (—Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, I will not treat this as the 
'answer.' ...I don't want to do something 
like that.)
"I understand. For now... I'll wait."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(To him, who believes in me and is waiting 
for me... I cannot bring back such a 
pathetic answer.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(To her, who believes in me and is waiting 
for me... I cannot bring back such a 
pathetic answer.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't want to show you only my 
uncool side, you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
âI saw it, I saw it~!! Those two really 
entered Ligne Droite on a "date" after 
all~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She seemed pretty restless in class, too, 
huh. A costumed pair dance, huh? Maybe 
I'll go check it out just to watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! Come to think of it, it's that time of 
year for Droite...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The "Ligne Droite," commonly known as the 
Droit... A dance party held at the academy 
in early spring, where students usually 
participate in pairs called a "date.")

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(With the new semester right around the 
corner, this event marks a "milestone" to 
wrap up the year alongside a worthy 
opponent—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"A clean break"... Maybe this really is 
good timing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I need to put an end to how I am now... 
constantly hesitating.

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon the interruption, everyone! Now 
that the party's in full swing, it's about 
time we move on to dance time!

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're with your special 'date', 
or a partner you just met here today! 
Please have a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Quite the success, isn't it—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Or rather... I feel completely out of 
place. I didn't plan on dancing, so I just 
came in my school uniform, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I'll watch from above.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...I feel sort of lightheaded. Almost 
like I've been swept up in the festive 
holiday air—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Oh! Well if it isn't Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Pocket-senpai. Are you 
participating in casual clothes? What 
about the dance...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the year I danced with Fuji-san, I 
went all out and nailed it, though.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I usually can't stand that stiff, formal 
stuff. I only dropped by this year to grab 
a bite to eat!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Have you eaten yet? It's pretty damn 
good, that big plate with... whatever that 
prosciutto stuff is!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pintxos, I see. ...I considered trying 
some, but I couldn't quite bring myself to 
reach for one.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...You feelin' down?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Downstairs, an elegant pair dance was 
unfolding to the rhythm of upbeat music.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Surrounded by all this bustling energy, 
...I felt as though my weakness, my 
pathetic state, might be forgiven just a 
little.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(—Before I knew it, I had opened up to my 
senior.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Not by laying everything bare, but rather 
bit by bit, spoken so faintly that her 
words were nearly drowned out by the 
music.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...So, there really wasn't much I could 
do.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have confidence in "myself."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry, Senpai. This isn't 
something we should be talking about 
during a celebration, is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please, go and enjoy yourself with the 
others. I'd like to stay here a little 
longer and think—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Beats me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah. Just feel like I don't get it. I 
mean... ah, what is it? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Huh? The music changed.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, this actually has a pretty good 
groove.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Let's head downstairs and dance, 
Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Hold on, Senpai—!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpai, um...! Aren't our outfits... 
really, very out of place here...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Who cares, don't sweat the small stuff! 
Putting the outfit aside—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm dancing pretty well, aren't I? Me! 
Even if it doesn't really suit my style.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
T-That's... well. You're certainly very 
skilled, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Right~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, Fuji-san really put me through 
the wringer with her training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san really is incredible. No matter 
what, she's always right at the center of 
my heart—the Umamusume I look up to most.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You spent so much time and effort on 
someone like me, who didn't know the first 
thing about pair dancing. You've given me 
something huge, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: But ya know—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hah, how's that, Messiah! —Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Right now! Who is it that's reflected in 
your eyes!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —It's... Pocket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Right here, right now, the one 
dancing with you isn't Fuji-san. —It's me!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Messiah. Even if it was all handed 
to you, you're the one who carried it 
across the finish line, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"There's no 'you as a daughter' or 'you as 
yourself.' Every bit of it is you, isn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head up high. At the very least, 
I think you're pretty darn good, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
How's that? ...Still not feeling confident 
even after this?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "No, Pocket-senpai. ...Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Wait, no, actually...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I've told ya before, just Pokke is fine, 
got it? No need to be all stiff and 
formal."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to express my respect. ...So I 
will keep calling you Pocket-senpai.

And then... with a remarkably bright and 
refreshed expression, Air Messiah spoke 
up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I would like to collect data.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As far as I know, this is the 
cleverest way to approach achieving our 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, I lacked the confidence. 
When it came to aspiring to carry on that 
legacy—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what I could possibly pass on 
to them. I was worried whether someone 
like me had anything worth giving at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I will not stand still any 
longer. Soundly. Steadily. I will think, 
and keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will collect data and conduct a 
comparative analysis. By learning more 
about others, I can bring my own contours 
into sharper focus.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Driven not by anxiety, but with hope in 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"What can I leave behind for the future?" 
...That is what I wish to ponder.

I nod in agreement with Air Messiah, her 
doubts now cleared. While training toward 
the Victoria Mile... let's gather it. That 
"data" she spoke of.

And so, let us bring it to light. The 
color and shape of the torch she passes on 
to her successors.
